svg.title: AnyScan architecture
svg.desc: AnyScan finds the objects in a camera frame, describes each one in words, and measures it in mm. A Basler camera captures a frame, which is undistorted when the camera is calibrated; FastSAM and background subtraction find the objects and are fused, so an object is kept if either finds it; each object is described by a local vision-language model and, when the camera is calibrated, measured in millimetres; the PyQt5 desktop application shows the result in its Live, Trends, History and Log views. Three files set the stages up: one YAML configuration per camera and mode, an optional calibration per camera, and the required empty-surface reference every frame is differenced against. Every analysis is recorded as a capture set, a row of the run summary CSV and the session log, which History and Log read back, and the session log is exported to the daily station event file. Built at JIC within the EDIH-DIGIMAT project, funded by the European Union.
